summary: Frontend-only verification of the new iter-385 'closeness ranking' feature in Home → Implant → Let Me Choose. Ranking math, header/hint, Best match badge and safety chips all behave as specified. Regression on Suggest Me tab is fine. Case Implant Planning in-case flow skipped (deep nav) — please self-test.

not_fully_verified: Show More / Show Less toggle — DOM click via dispatch events hit a parent wrapper (rect 358×2728) instead of the button; visually the 'Show More (22 more)' button IS rendered correctly. Logic is trivial (setShowAll toggle in tsx line 819-830), main agent can self-verify.

Alert.alert 'Bone height conflict' confirmation dialog on tap of unsafe row — on RN-Web the confirmation modal renders as a custom overlay; scripted pointer events dispatched but Exit/Continue could not be reliably reached in DOM inspection. Behaviour code path (implant-selection.tsx 662-692) is unchanged from prior iterations.
Give Drilling Protocol navigation after selecting a safe implant — same dispatch issue; visually the button becomes enabled once selection is made.
Case Implant Planning in-case 'Let Me Choose' — SKIPPED per request (deep nav).
notes: Request states 'Closest Matches (5 of 35)' but the actual DB catalogue for 'Cowellmedi – INNO Submerged' returns 27 sizes (dropdown label says '27 sizes | D: 3.5–6 mm | L: 7–18 mm'). The user's info of 35 is stale — 27 is the current backend truth and the UI correctly shows '(5 of 27)'. NOT a bug.

RN-Web quirk confirmed: data-testid on TouchableOpacity does NOT propagate to DOM. Tests had to use text selectors + synthesized PointerEvent dispatch. The 'system-option-N' data-testid is completely absent from DOM — recommend Main agent add native web props (accessibilityRole='button' or wrap Pressable) if better testability is desired.

Dropdown modal renders BELOW viewport bottom (y≈946 on 844-tall screen). scrollIntoView on inner divs does not scroll the modal FlatList; had to synthesize pointer events at off-screen coords. Users on real touch devices are unaffected — this is only a test-automation concern.
action_items: None blocking. Consider (nice-to-have) exposing accessible test IDs on TouchableOpacity option rows in Modal FlatList for future test automation.
Consider making the system-select Modal a full-height sheet so options aren't rendered below the viewport at 390×844.
critical_code_review_comments: rankImplantsByCloseness (implantSafety.ts:140-163) — correct implementation with weighted score and diameter tiebreaker; verified for 3 scenarios.

implant-selection.tsx:693 has a subtle formatting issue — the `visibleImplants` const declaration is jammed onto the same line as `const isUsingNarrowOptions = ...;` (two statements on one line). Non-functional, but ugly and easy to break. Consider splitting for readability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on verified acceptance criteria; 3 sub-tests unable to complete via automated dispatch (functional review only)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Automated tapping on RN-Web TouchableOpacity requires synthesized PointerEvent dispatch (see this script). For the system-select Modal, filter the FlatList by JS-fill into the search input first — options render at y>844 in mobile 390×844 viewport but are still clickable via dispatched PointerEvents at their off-screen coords.
